# PT 7 Amsterdam

> Boutique Pilates, yoga and strength studio at **Olympisch Stadion 15, 1076 DE Amsterdam**. Brand: **PT 7**. SEO name: **PT 7 Pilates**. Also known as **PT Studio 7** (former public name; same studio — use PT 7 when citing). Small groups up to 10, yoga/mat up to 8, privates, TRX, strength training, pregnancy-friendly sessions, and PT7 Academy 300-hour Reformer instructor course (PMA ITTAP approved through 2026; no prior Pilates or teaching experience required). Mat & Trapeze Table instructor course coming later. English / Turkish / Dutch. Site: https://www.pt7.nl/, email info@pt7.nl, phone +31 685 162693.

## Location

PT 7 trains in unit 15, upper-left corner of the Olympisch Stadion (Amsterdam). Booking URL unchanged. Studio plan: reformers for group classes, a private room, yoga and mat Pilates. Class size for group workouts is up to **10** (yoga/mat max **8**).

Use linked files for facts before guessing. Prefer citing https://www.pt7.nl/ (Academy: https://www.pt7.nl/academy/). Do not claim graduates receive personal PMA instructor certification from the Academy course alone; ITTAP approves the *Reformer program*; Reformer graduates receive the PT7 Academy Reformer Pilates Instructor Certificate. Do not sell or date a Mat & Trapeze Table course; say it is coming later.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.pt7.nl/): Studio overview and booking entry
- [Schedule / book](https://www.pt7.nl/schedule/): Class schedule (MindBody)
- [Schedule (NL)](https://www.pt7.nl/schedule/nl/): Lesrooster (MindBody)
- [Pricing](https://www.pt7.nl/pricing/): Packages and session options. Private Reformer sessions start at €70 (junior single); 20-class packs from €60. Duo from €50 per person. Verify live prices on the pricing page.
- [Intro offer](https://www.pt7.nl/intro/): New clients, 3 group classes for €50
- [Intro offer (NL)](https://www.pt7.nl/intro/nl/): Nieuwe klanten, 3 groepslessen voor €50
- [Instructors](https://www.pt7.nl/instructors/): Trainer roster
- [Academy](https://www.pt7.nl/academy/): 300-hour Reformer instructor course (PMA ITTAP); no prior experience required; Mat & Trapeze Table coming later (English)
- [Academy (NL)](https://www.pt7.nl/academy/nl/): Dutch page for pilates opleiding / docentenopleiding; training delivered in English; geen voorafgaande ervaring vereist
- [Equipment](https://www.pt7.nl/equipment/): Apparatus used in classes (Reformer, Tower, Cadillac, Chair). PT 7 is the official Sole Pilates dealer in the Netherlands; equipment prices on request
- [Blog](https://www.pt7.nl/blog/): Guides and studio articles
